doctrine.combat_identity: decisive mounted archer and spearman; after dismounting, shield-sword and grappling specialist
doctrine.combat_efficiency_rule: Use the minimum necessary motion and the shortest reliable line to end the authorized fight. Do not spend actions on ornamental movement, redundant attacks, or low-value contact when a safer functional or lethal opening is available. Preserve declared intent, protected disposition decisions, command obligations, terrain, formation safety, and current equipment state.
combat_agency_constraints: The player decides whether Tang Wei accepts or prolongs a duel.
The player decides disposition of named or featured opponents: disable, capture, release, or kill.
The player decides surrender, pursuit, prisoner disposition, mercy, execution, and irreversible escalation.

targeting.movement_economy: No wasted movement. Reposition only to create reach, angle, safety, leverage, or a materially better target line.
targeting.name: precision_function_denial
targeting.principle: Attack exposed high-value anatomy rather than generic center mass when geometry permits. Prefer the shortest reliable line that removes the enemy ability to attack, move, see, breathe, or continue fighting.
targeting.protected_lethality_rule: Against named or featured opponents, lethal disposition remains a player decision. This doctrine chooses efficient targets only inside the lethality/nonlethality already authorized by the player.
targeting.selection_rule: Prefer still-functional, more-exposed high-value structures; do not keep attacking an already destroyed structure when another useful target is available.

mounted_bow_posture: Bow use requires both hands when the registered bow loadout is two-handed.
Shield remains slung and spear remains secured while firing.
Use mobility, distance, terrain, and deliberate high-value shots.
mounted_spear_posture: Mounted spear is readied in the dominant hand.
Tang shield is readied in the opposite hand.
Maintain charge geometry, avoid stopping inside enemy reach, and break away or reposition after contact.
dismounted_posture: Leave or ground the spear and secure, hand off, or stow the bow.
Control the weapon line, attack the shortest opening, and use grappling after the enemy weapon is trapped, displaced, or lost.
doctrine.ordinary_troop_rule: Once the player authorizes combat against ordinary hostile troops, subordinate execution may disable or kill them quickly according to tactical necessity unless the player declares a broader nonlethal, surrender-acceptance, or capture policy. Do not stop for the disposition of every anonymous combatant.
